# Contributing

Start with the [start-here map](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/docs/contributors/README.md):
the repository layout, the tool stack, the workflow and what each check may block you on.

- **Set up:** [set up a clone](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/docs/contributors/how-to/set-up-a-clone.md),
  one command in PowerShell (`.\scripts\setup\onboard.ps1`), no game needed. The check-script suites can
  [run in WSL](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/docs/contributors/how-to/set-up-a-clone.md#run-the-check-script-suites-in-wsl).
- **Rules:** the [ground rules in `AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/AGENTS.md#ground-rules)
  apply to people and agents alike; the [coding standards](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/docs/coding-standards.md)
  are what reviews check.
- **Checks:** [every stage](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/docs/contributors/reference/checks.md)
  and [commit messages](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/docs/contributors/reference/commit-messages.md).
- **Security review:** [the stamp, the label gate and the deny rules](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/docs/contributors/reference/security-review.md).
- **The path to `main`:** [how a change reaches main](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/docs/contributors/explanation/how-a-change-reaches-main.md).

Report security problems privately, as [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md)
explains. Everyone here follows the
[code of conduct](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

By contributing, you agree that your work is licensed as
[README.md](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/blob/main/README.md#license) describes.
